tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

19	def _resolve_kv_heads(input, scatter_idx, seq_world_size, num_kv_heads):
20	    """KV head count this all-to-all partitions against, or None when the caller has none.
21	
22	    Only the scatter direction can read a count off the tensor; the gather direction and
23	    ``_SeqAllToAll.backward`` see an already-sharded head dim. The value resolved here is
24	    therefore carried on the autograd context and replayed, rather than recomputed or kept
25	    process-wide where a second model would inherit it.
26	    """
27	    if num_kv_heads is None and not scatter_idx < 2 and input.shape[2] % seq_world_size != 0:
28	        # Scatter direction, so dim 2 is still the full head dim and an uneven count is visible
29	        # here. Taking it as the partition basis assumes one KV group per head: under GQA a
30	        # query tensor carries a multiple of the KV group count, and splitting on that number
31	        # would tear a group across ranks. GQA callers pass the count in instead.
32	        num_kv_heads = input.shape[2]
33	
34	    if num_kv_heads is not None:
35	        assert num_kv_heads >= seq_world_size, (
36	            f"Number of key-value heads ({num_kv_heads}) must be at least the sequence parallel "
37	            f"size ({seq_world_size}); a smaller count leaves a rank with no head to attend over.")
38	
39	    return num_kv_heads
40	
41	
42	try:
43	    from torchembed._triton import fused_rope_forward as _torchembed_rope_forward
44	    _torchembed_available = True
45	except ImportError:
46	    _torchembed_available = False
47

49	def _generate_layout_params(scatter_idx, batch_dim_idx, seq_world_size, input):
50	    """
51	    This function generates the parameters required for `permute` and `reshape` operations,
52	    which are used to process data before and after `all2all` communication.
53	    """
54	    if batch_dim_idx == 0:
55	        if scatter_idx < 2:
56	            bs, global_seq_len, num_local_head, head_dim = input.shape
57	            assert global_seq_len % seq_world_size == 0, (
58	                f"Sequence length ({global_seq_len}) must be divisible by the sequence parallel size ({seq_world_size})!"
59	            )
60	            pre_all2all_inp_shape = [bs, seq_world_size, global_seq_len // seq_world_size, num_local_head, head_dim]
61	            pre_all2all_permute_idx = (1, 0, 2, 3, 4)
62	
63	            post_all2all_permute_idx = (1, 2, 0, 3, 4)
64	            post_all2all_res_shape = [bs, global_seq_len // seq_world_size, seq_world_size * num_local_head, head_dim]
65	        else:
66	            bs, local_seq_len, num_total_head, head_dim = input.shape
67	            assert num_total_head % seq_world_size == 0, f"Number of heads ({num_total_head}) must be divisible by the sequence parallel size ({seq_world_size})!"
68	            pre_all2all_inp_shape = [bs, local_seq_len, seq_world_size, num_total_head // seq_world_size, head_dim]
69	            pre_all2all_permute_idx = (2, 0, 1, 3, 4)
70	
71	            post_all2all_permute_idx = (1, 0, 2, 3, 4)
72	            post_all2all_res_shape = [bs, seq_world_size * local_seq_len, num_total_head // seq_world_size, head_dim]
73	    else:
74	        if scatter_idx < 2:
75	            global_seq_len, bs, num_local_head, head_dim = input.shape
76	            assert global_seq_len % seq_world_size == 0, (
77	                f"Sequence length ({global_seq_len}) must be divisible by the sequence parallel size ({seq_world_size})!"
78	            )
79	            pre_all2all_inp_shape = [seq_world_size, global_seq_len // seq_world_size, bs, num_local_head, head_dim]
80	            pre_all2all_permute_idx = None
81	
82	            post_all2all_permute_idx = (1, 2, 0, 3, 4)
83	            # seq-first layout: the all2all scatters the sequence and gathers the heads, so the
84	            # result keeps bs in dim 1 with a local sequence and every rank's heads.
85	            post_all2all_res_shape = [global_seq_len // seq_world_size, bs, seq_world_size * num_local_head, head_dim]
86	        else:
87	            local_seq_len, bs, num_total_head, head_dim = input.shape
88	            assert num_total_head % seq_world_size == 0, f"Number of heads ({num_total_head}) must be divisible by the sequence parallel size ({seq_world_size})!"
89	            pre_all2all_inp_shape = [local_seq_len, bs, seq_world_size, num_total_head // seq_world_size, head_dim]
90	            pre_all2all_permute_idx = (2, 0, 1, 3, 4)
91	            post_all2all_permute_idx = None
92	            post_all2all_res_shape = [local_seq_len * seq_world_size, bs, num_total_head // seq_world_size, head_dim]
93	
94	    return pre_all2all_permute_idx, pre_all2all_inp_shape, post_all2all_permute_idx, post_all2all_res_shape

105	        output = input.reshape(res_shape).contiguous()

117	    if permute_idx is not None:

122	def _rotate_half(x):
123	    """
124	    change sign so the last dimension becomes [-odd, +even]
125	    """
126	    x = rearrange(x, '... (j d) -> ... j d', j=2)
127	    x1, x2 = x.unbind(dim=-2)
128	    return torch.cat((-x2, x1), dim=-1)
129

131	def apply_rotary_pos_emb(t, freqs_cos, freqs_sin):
132	    """
133	    input tensor t is of shape [seq_length, ..., dim]
134	    rotary positional embeding tensor freqs is of shape [seq_length, ..., dim]
135	    check https://kexue.fm/archives/8265 for detailed formulas
136	    """
137	    rot_dim = freqs_cos.shape[-1]
138	    # ideally t_pass is empty so rotary pos embedding is applied to all tensor t
139	    t, t_pass = t[..., :rot_dim], t[..., rot_dim:]
140	
141	    # torchembed's fused kernel takes cos/sin caches of shape [seq_length, rot_dim] and
142	    # applies them along the second-to-last axis of t. Some callers (e.g. fpdt_layer.py)
143	    # pass tensors where the sequence dim isn't at position 0, so only take the fused path
144	    # when t's dim 0 unambiguously matches the freqs' sequence dim (with no other
145	    # non-broadcast dims in freqs); otherwise fall back to the reference path.
146	    if (_torchembed_available and get_accelerator().on_accelerator(t) and rot_dim % 2 == 0
147	            and freqs_cos.shape[0] == t.shape[0] and freqs_cos.numel() == freqs_cos.shape[0] * rot_dim):
148	        freqs_cos_2d = freqs_cos.reshape(freqs_cos.shape[0], rot_dim)
149	        freqs_sin_2d = freqs_sin.reshape(freqs_sin.shape[0], rot_dim)
150	        # torchembed expects the sequence dim second-to-last: (*leading, seq_len, dim)
151	        t_kernel = t.movedim(0, -2).contiguous()
152	        t_out, _ = _torchembed_rope_forward(t_kernel, t_kernel, freqs_cos_2d, freqs_sin_2d)
153	        t = t_out.movedim(-2, 0).contiguous()
154	    else:
155	        # first part is cosine component
156	        # second part is sine component, need to change signs with _rotate_half method
157	        t = (t * freqs_cos) + (_rotate_half(t) * freqs_sin)
158	
159	    res = t if t_pass.shape[-1] == 0 else torch.cat((t, t_pass), dim=-1)
160	    return res

163	def uneven_heads_all2all(input, scatter_idx, gather_idx, batch_dim_idx, group, num_kv_heads):
164	    seq_world_size = dist.get_world_size(group)
165	    # AutoTPMeta is built here rather than threaded: the partition follows this all-to-all's own
166	    # KV count, and the shard helper is the only thing that needs it in that shape.
167	    meta = AutoTPMeta(num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads)
168	    inp_shape = list(input.shape)
169	    assert batch_dim_idx in [0, 1], "batch_dim_idx must be either 0 or 1"
170	
171	    if not (scatter_idx < 2):
172	        input_splits = get_shard_size_list(inp_shape[scatter_idx], seq_world_size, meta)
173	        input = input.transpose(0, scatter_idx).contiguous()
174	        local_heads = input_splits[groups._get_sequence_parallel_rank()]
175	        output_splits = [local_heads] * seq_world_size
176	
177	        output_buffer_shape = [seq_world_size * local_heads] + list(input.shape[1:])
178	        output = torch.empty(output_buffer_shape, device=input.device, dtype=input.dtype)
179	        dist.all_to_all_single(output,input,output_split_sizes=output_splits,\
180	            input_split_sizes=input_splits,group=group)
181	        ###[seq_ws*local_heads, ...] to [seq_ws, local_heads, ...]
182	        output = output.view(seq_world_size, local_heads, *output.shape[1:])
183	        ###[seq_ws,local_heads,b,seq_len,...] to [seq_ws,seq_len,b,local_heads,...]
184	
185	        ### batch_dim_idx=0 [seq_ws,local_heads,seq_len,b,...] to [b, seq_ws, seq_len, local_heads ...]
186	        ### batch_dim_idx=1 [seq_ws,local_heads,b,seq_len,...] to [seq_ws,seq_len,b,local_heads,...]
187	        if batch_dim_idx == 0:
188	            order = [3, 0, 2, 1] + list(range(4, len(output.shape)))
189	            output = output.permute(order).contiguous()
190	            ###[b, seq_ws*local_seq_len, local_heads,...]
191	            output = output.view(output.shape[0], inp_shape[gather_idx] * seq_world_size,
192	                                 *output.shape[3:]).contiguous()
193	        elif batch_dim_idx == 1:
194	            output = output.transpose(1, 3).contiguous()
195	            ###[seq_ws*local_seq_len, b, local_heads,...]
196	            output = output.view(inp_shape[gather_idx] * seq_world_size, *output.shape[2:]).contiguous()
197	    else:
198	        # The compatibility handling of 4D and 3D tensors, standardizing to 3D.
199	        input = input.reshape(input.shape[0], input.shape[1], -1)
200	
201	        if batch_dim_idx == 0:  #b,s,h
202	            input = input.permute(1, 2, 0).contiguous()  #s,h,b
203	        elif batch_dim_idx == 1:  #s,b,h
204	            input = input.transpose(1, 2).contiguous()  #s,h,b
205	        seq_len, h, batch_size = input.shape
206	        num_local_heads_list = get_shard_size_list(num_kv_heads, seq_world_size, meta)
207	        local_heads = num_local_heads_list[groups._get_sequence_parallel_rank()]
208	        h_dim = h // local_heads
209	        local_seq_len = seq_len // seq_world_size
210	
211	        input = input.view(seq_len * h, batch_size)
212	        local_seq_len_with_heads = int(input.shape[0] / seq_world_size)  # dim size of local_seq_len*local_heads*hdim
213	        input_splits = [local_seq_len_with_heads] * seq_world_size
214	        coeff = local_seq_len_with_heads // local_heads  #per head: dim size of local_seq_len*hdim
215	
216	        #uneven seq_world_size coeff,  total_heads/local_heads.
217	        heads_scale_coeff = num_kv_heads / local_heads
218	
219	        output_splits = [num_local_heads * coeff for num_local_heads in num_local_heads_list]
220	        output_buff_d1_size = int(heads_scale_coeff * local_seq_len_with_heads)
221	        total_h = int(inp_shape[gather_idx] * heads_scale_coeff)
222	        output = torch.empty(output_buff_d1_size, input.shape[1], device=input.device, dtype=input.dtype)
223	        dist.all_to_all_single(output,input,output_split_sizes=output_splits, \
224	            input_split_sizes=input_splits,group=group)
225	        ##################
226	        #suppose 7 heads divide into 4 ranks [2,2,2,1]
227	        #chunk_num_heads_small=floor(7/4)=1
228	        #chunk_num_heads_large=ceil(7/4)=2
229	        #num_chunk_heads_large=len([2,2,2])=3, all2all_buffer_counts
230	        #num_chunk_heads_small=len([1])=1, all2all_buffer_counts
231	        #total_num_large_heads=sum([2,2,2])=7
232	        #total_num_small_heads=sum([1])=1
233	
234	        chunk_num_heads_small = num_kv_heads // seq_world_size  # even heads compatible
235	        chunk_num_heads_large = chunk_num_heads_small + 1
236	        num_chunk_heads_large = num_kv_heads % seq_world_size
237	        num_chunk_heads_small = seq_world_size - num_chunk_heads_large
238	        total_num_large_heads = num_chunk_heads_large * chunk_num_heads_large
239	        total_num_small_heads = num_chunk_heads_small * chunk_num_heads_small
240	
241	        heads_large_combine_size = coeff * total_num_large_heads
242	        heads_small_combine_size = coeff * total_num_small_heads
243	        heads_large_chunk, heads_small_chunk = output.split([heads_large_combine_size, heads_small_combine_size],
244	                                                            dim=0)
245	        heads_large_chunk = heads_large_chunk.view(num_chunk_heads_large, local_seq_len, chunk_num_heads_large, h_dim,
246	                                                   batch_size)
247	        heads_small_chunk = heads_small_chunk.view(num_chunk_heads_small, local_seq_len, chunk_num_heads_small, h_dim,
248	                                                   batch_size)
249	        if batch_dim_idx == 0:
250	            #[all2all_buffer_counts, local_seq_len, n_heads,dim,batch]->[batch,local_seq_len,all2all_buffer_counts*n_heads,dim]
251	            order = [4, 1, 0, 2, 3]
252	            heads_large_chunk = heads_large_chunk.permute(order).contiguous().view(batch_size, local_seq_len,
253	                                                                                   total_num_large_heads, h_dim)
254	            heads_small_chunk = heads_small_chunk.permute(order).contiguous().view(batch_size, local_seq_len,
255	                                                                                   total_num_small_heads, h_dim)
256	        elif batch_dim_idx == 1:
257	            #[all2all_buffer_counts, local_seq_len, n_heads,dim,batch]->[local_seq_len,batch,all2all_buffer_counts*n_heads,dim]
258	            order = [1, 4, 0, 2, 3]
259	            heads_large_chunk = heads_large_chunk.permute(order).contiguous().view(local_seq_len, batch_size,
260	                                                                                   total_num_large_heads, h_dim)
261	            heads_small_chunk = heads_small_chunk.permute(order).contiguous().view(local_seq_len, batch_size,
262	                                                                                   total_num_small_heads, h_dim)
263	
264	        output = torch.cat([heads_large_chunk, heads_small_chunk], dim=2).contiguous()
265	
266	        inp_shape[scatter_idx] = inp_shape[scatter_idx] // seq_world_size
267	        output_shape=  inp_shape[: gather_idx] + \
268	            [total_h,] + \
269	            inp_shape[gather_idx + 1:]
270	
271	        output = output.view(output_shape)
272	
273	    return output

276	def single_all_to_all(input,
277	                      scatter_idx,
278	                      gather_idx,
279	                      batch_dim_idx,
280	                      group,
281	                      async_op=False,
282	                      handle=None,
283	                      type=None,
284	                      num_kv_heads=None):
285	    seq_world_size = dist.get_world_size(group)
286	
287	    num_kv_heads = _resolve_kv_heads(input, scatter_idx, seq_world_size, num_kv_heads)
288	
289	    # Only an indivisible count needs the uneven implementation. Taking it for every explicit
290	    # count would push evenly-split models onto it too, and it rejects async_op, which is how
291	    # the overlapped q/k path runs.
292	    if num_kv_heads is not None and num_kv_heads % seq_world_size != 0:
293	        assert async_op == False, "uneven head sp does not support async op"
294	        return uneven_heads_all2all(input, scatter_idx, gather_idx, batch_dim_idx, group, num_kv_heads)
295	
296	    pre_all2all_permute_idx, pre_all2all_inp_shape, post_all2all_permute_idx, post_all2all_res_shape = _generate_layout_params(
297	        scatter_idx, batch_dim_idx, seq_world_size, input)
298	
299	    input_t = pre_all2all_fun(pre_all2all_permute_idx, pre_all2all_inp_shape, input)
300	
301	    post_all2all_fun = post_all2all(post_all2all_permute_idx, post_all2all_res_shape)
302	    output = torch.empty_like(input_t)
303	    work = dist.all_to_all_single(output, input_t, group=group, async_op=async_op)
304	
305	    if async_op:
306	        if type in ('dq', 'dk'):
307	            handle[type + '_work'] = work
308	            handle[type + '_grad'] = output
309	            handle[type + '_post_all2all_func'] = post_all2all_fun
310	            return output.view(post_all2all_res_shape)
311	
312	    res = post_all2all_fun(output)
313	    return res
314	
315	
316	# A process group cannot appear in an operator schema, so the exchange addresses its group by name and
317	# resolves the name back to the group when it runs. The registry is written once, when the attention module
318	# is built: a write issued from inside a compiled region does not land before the operator reads it.
319	_all_to_all_groups: Dict[str, dist.ProcessGroup] = {}
320	
321	
322	def register_all_to_all_group(group: dist.ProcessGroup) -> str:
323	    """Make ``group`` reachable by name from inside the exchange operator, and return that name.
324	
325	    Call this outside any compiled region, before the first exchange on ``group``.
326	    """

480	            partition follows. Only needed when it does not divide evenly by the sequence
481	            parallel world size; when omitted it is read from the key tensor of each forward.
482	        validate_shards (bool): check that each of Q, K and V has the same sequence length
483	            on every sequence-group rank before each forward's attention data collectives.
484	            Adds one metadata all-gather and host synchronization per forward; disabled by default.
485	            All group members must enable this flag consistently and participate in every forward.
486	            Inconsistent flags cannot be detected without communication in the default path.
487	            Only sequence lengths are checked, not other shapes, dtypes or devices. Query and
488	            KV sequence lengths may differ. No padding is added: callers must provide equal
489	            shards and own any padding, attention masks and loss masking.
490	    """
491	
492	    def __init__(
493	        self,
494	        local_attention: Module,
495	        sequence_process_group: dist.ProcessGroup,
496	        scatter_idx: int = 2,
497	        gather_idx: int = 0,
498	        sp_stream=None,
499	        num_kv_heads: int = None,
500	        validate_shards: bool = False,
501	    ) -> None:

503	        super(DistributedAttention, self).__init__()
504	        self.local_attn = local_attention
505	        self.spg = sequence_process_group
506	        # Kept per instance: a second model with a different head count must not decide how this
507	        # one is sharded.
508	        self.num_kv_heads = num_kv_heads
509	        self.validate_shards = validate_shards
510	        self.scatter_idx = scatter_idx
511	        self.gather_idx = gather_idx
512	        self.sp_overlap_comm = False
513	        self.overlap_handles = None
514	        self.sp_stream = sp_stream

516	            self.overlap_handles = {}
517	            self.sp_overlap_comm = True

520	    def _validate_shard_lengths(self, query, key, value, batch_dim_idx):
521	        seq_dim = 1 - batch_dim_idx
522	        lengths = torch.tensor([tensor.shape[seq_dim] for tensor in (query, key, value)],
523	                               dtype=torch.int64,
524	                               device=query.device)
525	        gathered = [torch.empty_like(lengths) for _ in range(dist.get_world_size(self.spg))]
526	        dist.all_gather(gathered, lengths, group=self.spg)
527	        rank_lengths = [metadata.tolist() for metadata in gathered]
528	        mismatches = []
529	        for index, name in enumerate(('query', 'key', 'value')):
530	            sizes = [metadata[index] for metadata in rank_lengths]
531	            if any(size != sizes[0] for size in sizes[1:]):
532	                details = ', '.join(f'group rank {rank}: {size}' for rank, size in enumerate(sizes))
533	                mismatches.append(f'{name} sequence lengths [{details}]')
534	        if mismatches:

536	                             '; '.join(mismatches))

542	    def forward(self,
543	                query: Tensor,
544	                key: Tensor,
545	                value: Tensor,
546	                batch_dim_idx: int,
547	                rotary_pos_emb=None,
548	                *args: Any,
549	                **kwargs) -> Tensor:
550	        """ forward
551	
552	        Arguments:
553	            query (Tensor): query input to the layer
554	            key (Tensor): key input to the layer
555	            value (Tensor): value input to the layer
556	            batch_dim_idx (int): indicating which dim is batch
557	            args: other args
558	
559	        Returns:
560	            * output (Tensor): context output

563	        if self.validate_shards:
564	            self._validate_shard_lengths(query, key, value, batch_dim_idx)
565	
566	        # TODO Merge three alltoall calls into one
567	        # TODO (Reza): change the api on the megatron-deepspeed side so that we only receive all data (q,k, and v) together!
568	        #in shape : e.g.,  [s/p:h:]

570	        def bwd_hook(layer_type):
571	
572	            def hook_fun(grad):
573	                type = 'd' + layer_type
574	                self.overlap_handles[type + '_work'].wait()
575	                self.sp_stream.wait_stream(self.default_stream)

577	                return self.overlap_handles[type + '_post_all2all_func'](all2all_output)

# Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

# DeepSpeed Team
import torch

from typing import Any, Dict, Tuple
from torch import Tensor
from torch.nn import Module

from einops import rearrange

import deepspeed.comm as dist
from deepspeed.accelerator import get_accelerator
from deepspeed.module_inject.tp_shard import AutoTPMeta, get_shard_size_list
from deepspeed.utils import groups


def _resolve_kv_heads(input, scatter_idx, seq_world_size, num_kv_heads):
    """KV head count this all-to-all partitions against, or None when the caller has none.

    Only the scatter direction can read a count off the tensor; the gather direction and
    ``_SeqAllToAll.backward`` see an already-sharded head dim. The value resolved here is
    therefore carried on the autograd context and replayed, rather than recomputed or kept
    process-wide where a second model would inherit it.
    """
    if num_kv_heads is None and not scatter_idx < 2 and input.shape[2] % seq_world_size != 0:
        # Scatter direction, so dim 2 is still the full head dim and an uneven count is visible
        # here. Taking it as the partition basis assumes one KV group per head: under GQA a
        # query tensor carries a multiple of the KV group count, and splitting on that number
        # would tear a group across ranks. GQA callers pass the count in instead.
        num_kv_heads = input.shape[2]

    if num_kv_heads is not None:
        assert num_kv_heads >= seq_world_size, (
            f"Number of key-value heads ({num_kv_heads}) must be at least the sequence parallel "
            f"size ({seq_world_size}); a smaller count leaves a rank with no head to attend over.")

    return num_kv_heads


try:
    from torchembed._triton import fused_rope_forward as _torchembed_rope_forward
    _torchembed_available = True
except ImportError:
    _torchembed_available = False


def _generate_layout_params(scatter_idx, batch_dim_idx, seq_world_size, input):
    """
    This function generates the parameters required for `permute` and `reshape` operations,
    which are used to process data before and after `all2all` communication.
    """
    if batch_dim_idx == 0:
        if scatter_idx < 2:
            bs, global_seq_len, num_local_head, head_dim = input.shape
            assert global_seq_len % seq_world_size == 0, (
                f"Sequence length ({global_seq_len}) must be divisible by the sequence parallel size ({seq_world_size})!"
            )
            pre_all2all_inp_shape = [bs, seq_world_size, global_seq_len // seq_world_size, num_local_head, head_dim]
            pre_all2all_permute_idx = (1, 0, 2, 3, 4)

            post_all2all_permute_idx = (1, 2, 0, 3, 4)
            post_all2all_res_shape = [bs, global_seq_len // seq_world_size, seq_world_size * num_local_head, head_dim]
        else:
            bs, local_seq_len, num_total_head, head_dim = input.shape
            assert num_total_head % seq_world_size == 0, f"Number of heads ({num_total_head}) must be divisible by the sequence parallel size ({seq_world_size})!"
            pre_all2all_inp_shape = [bs, local_seq_len, seq_world_size, num_total_head // seq_world_size, head_dim]
            pre_all2all_permute_idx = (2, 0, 1, 3, 4)

            post_all2all_permute_idx = (1, 0, 2, 3, 4)
            post_all2all_res_shape = [bs, seq_world_size * local_seq_len, num_total_head // seq_world_size, head_dim]
    else:
        if scatter_idx < 2:
            global_seq_len, bs, num_local_head, head_dim = input.shape
            assert global_seq_len % seq_world_size == 0, (
                f"Sequence length ({global_seq_len}) must be divisible by the sequence parallel size ({seq_world_size})!"
            )
            pre_all2all_inp_shape = [seq_world_size, global_seq_len // seq_world_size, bs, num_local_head, head_dim]
            pre_all2all_permute_idx = None

            post_all2all_permute_idx = (1, 2, 0, 3, 4)
            # seq-first layout: the all2all scatters the sequence and gathers the heads, so the
            # result keeps bs in dim 1 with a local sequence and every rank's heads.
            post_all2all_res_shape = [global_seq_len // seq_world_size, bs, seq_world_size * num_local_head, head_dim]
        else:
            local_seq_len, bs, num_total_head, head_dim = input.shape
            assert num_total_head % seq_world_size == 0, f"Number of heads ({num_total_head}) must be divisible by the sequence parallel size ({seq_world_size})!"
            pre_all2all_inp_shape = [local_seq_len, bs, seq_world_size, num_total_head // seq_world_size, head_dim]
            pre_all2all_permute_idx = (2, 0, 1, 3, 4)
            post_all2all_permute_idx = None
            post_all2all_res_shape = [local_seq_len * seq_world_size, bs, num_total_head // seq_world_size, head_dim]

    return pre_all2all_permute_idx, pre_all2all_inp_shape, post_all2all_permute_idx, post_all2all_res_shape


def post_all2all(permute_idx, res_shape):
    """
    Post-processing function for `all2all` communication.
    """

    def post_func(input):
        if permute_idx is not None:
            input = input.permute(permute_idx).contiguous()
        output = input.reshape(res_shape).contiguous()

        return output

    return post_func


def pre_all2all_fun(permute_idx, inp_shape, input):
    """
    Pre-processing function for `all2all` communication.
    """
    input_t = input.reshape(inp_shape).contiguous()
    if permute_idx is not None:
        input_t = input_t.permute(permute_idx).contiguous()
    return input_t


def _rotate_half(x):
    """
    change sign so the last dimension becomes [-odd, +even]
    """
    x = rearrange(x, '... (j d) -> ... j d', j=2)
    x1, x2 = x.unbind(dim=-2)
    return torch.cat((-x2, x1), dim=-1)


def apply_rotary_pos_emb(t, freqs_cos, freqs_sin):
    """
    input tensor t is of shape [seq_length, ..., dim]
    rotary positional embeding tensor freqs is of shape [seq_length, ..., dim]
    check https://kexue.fm/archives/8265 for detailed formulas
    """
    rot_dim = freqs_cos.shape[-1]
    # ideally t_pass is empty so rotary pos embedding is applied to all tensor t
    t, t_pass = t[..., :rot_dim], t[..., rot_dim:]

    # torchembed's fused kernel takes cos/sin caches of shape [seq_length, rot_dim] and
    # applies them along the second-to-last axis of t. Some callers (e.g. fpdt_layer.py)
    # pass tensors where the sequence dim isn't at position 0, so only take the fused path
    # when t's dim 0 unambiguously matches the freqs' sequence dim (with no other
    # non-broadcast dims in freqs); otherwise fall back to the reference path.
    if (_torchembed_available and get_accelerator().on_accelerator(t) and rot_dim % 2 == 0
            and freqs_cos.shape[0] == t.shape[0] and freqs_cos.numel() == freqs_cos.shape[0] * rot_dim):
        freqs_cos_2d = freqs_cos.reshape(freqs_cos.shape[0], rot_dim)
        freqs_sin_2d = freqs_sin.reshape(freqs_sin.shape[0], rot_dim)
        # torchembed expects the sequence dim second-to-last: (*leading, seq_len, dim)
        t_kernel = t.movedim(0, -2).contiguous()
        t_out, _ = _torchembed_rope_forward(t_kernel, t_kernel, freqs_cos_2d, freqs_sin_2d)
        t = t_out.movedim(-2, 0).contiguous()
    else:
        # first part is cosine component
        # second part is sine component, need to change signs with _rotate_half method
        t = (t * freqs_cos) + (_rotate_half(t) * freqs_sin)

    res = t if t_pass.shape[-1] == 0 else torch.cat((t, t_pass), dim=-1)
    return res


def uneven_heads_all2all(input, scatter_idx, gather_idx, batch_dim_idx, group, num_kv_heads):
    seq_world_size = dist.get_world_size(group)
    # AutoTPMeta is built here rather than threaded: the partition follows this all-to-all's own
    # KV count, and the shard helper is the only thing that needs it in that shape.
    meta = AutoTPMeta(num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads)
    inp_shape = list(input.shape)
    assert batch_dim_idx in [0, 1], "batch_dim_idx must be either 0 or 1"

    if not (scatter_idx < 2):
        input_splits = get_shard_size_list(inp_shape[scatter_idx], seq_world_size, meta)
        input = input.transpose(0, scatter_idx).contiguous()
        local_heads = input_splits[groups._get_sequence_parallel_rank()]
        output_splits = [local_heads] * seq_world_size

        output_buffer_shape = [seq_world_size * local_heads] + list(input.shape[1:])
        output = torch.empty(output_buffer_shape, device=input.device, dtype=input.dtype)
        dist.all_to_all_single(output,input,output_split_sizes=output_splits,\
            input_split_sizes=input_splits,group=group)
        ###[seq_ws*local_heads, ...] to [seq_ws, local_heads, ...]
        output = output.view(seq_world_size, local_heads, *output.shape[1:])
        ###[seq_ws,local_heads,b,seq_len,...] to [seq_ws,seq_len,b,local_heads,...]

        ### batch_dim_idx=0 [seq_ws,local_heads,seq_len,b,...] to [b, seq_ws, seq_len, local_heads ...]
        ### batch_dim_idx=1 [seq_ws,local_heads,b,seq_len,...] to [seq_ws,seq_len,b,local_heads,...]
        if batch_dim_idx == 0:
            order = [3, 0, 2, 1] + list(range(4, len(output.shape)))
            output = output.permute(order).contiguous()
            ###[b, seq_ws*local_seq_len, local_heads,...]
            output = output.view(output.shape[0], inp_shape[gather_idx] * seq_world_size,
                                 *output.shape[3:]).contiguous()
        elif batch_dim_idx == 1:
            output = output.transpose(1, 3).contiguous()
            ###[seq_ws*local_seq_len, b, local_heads,...]
            output = output.view(inp_shape[gather_idx] * seq_world_size, *output.shape[2:]).contiguous()
    else:
        # The compatibility handling of 4D and 3D tensors, standardizing to 3D.
        input = input.reshape(input.shape[0], input.shape[1], -1)

        if batch_dim_idx == 0:  #b,s,h
            input = input.permute(1, 2, 0).contiguous()  #s,h,b
        elif batch_dim_idx == 1:  #s,b,h
            input = input.transpose(1, 2).contiguous()  #s,h,b
        seq_len, h, batch_size = input.shape
        num_local_heads_list = get_shard_size_list(num_kv_heads, seq_world_size, meta)
        local_heads = num_local_heads_list[groups._get_sequence_parallel_rank()]
        h_dim = h // local_heads
        local_seq_len = seq_len // seq_world_size

        input = input.view(seq_len * h, batch_size)
        local_seq_len_with_heads = int(input.shape[0] / seq_world_size)  # dim size of local_seq_len*local_heads*hdim
        input_splits = [local_seq_len_with_heads] * seq_world_size
        coeff = local_seq_len_with_heads // local_heads  #per head: dim size of local_seq_len*hdim

        #uneven seq_world_size coeff,  total_heads/local_heads.
        heads_scale_coeff = num_kv_heads / local_heads

        output_splits = [num_local_heads * coeff for num_local_heads in num_local_heads_list]
        output_buff_d1_size = int(heads_scale_coeff * local_seq_len_with_heads)
        total_h = int(inp_shape[gather_idx] * heads_scale_coeff)
        output = torch.empty(output_buff_d1_size, input.shape[1], device=input.device, dtype=input.dtype)
        dist.all_to_all_single(output,input,output_split_sizes=output_splits, \
            input_split_sizes=input_splits,group=group)
        ##################
        #suppose 7 heads divide into 4 ranks [2,2,2,1]
        #chunk_num_heads_small=floor(7/4)=1
        #chunk_num_heads_large=ceil(7/4)=2
        #num_chunk_heads_large=len([2,2,2])=3, all2all_buffer_counts
        #num_chunk_heads_small=len([1])=1, all2all_buffer_counts
        #total_num_large_heads=sum([2,2,2])=7
        #total_num_small_heads=sum([1])=1

        chunk_num_heads_small = num_kv_heads // seq_world_size  # even heads compatible
        chunk_num_heads_large = chunk_num_heads_small + 1
        num_chunk_heads_large = num_kv_heads % seq_world_size
        num_chunk_heads_small = seq_world_size - num_chunk_heads_large
        total_num_large_heads = num_chunk_heads_large * chunk_num_heads_large
        total_num_small_heads = num_chunk_heads_small * chunk_num_heads_small

        heads_large_combine_size = coeff * total_num_large_heads
        heads_small_combine_size = coeff * total_num_small_heads
        heads_large_chunk, heads_small_chunk = output.split([heads_large_combine_size, heads_small_combine_size],
                                                            dim=0)
        heads_large_chunk = heads_large_chunk.view(num_chunk_heads_large, local_seq_len, chunk_num_heads_large, h_dim,
                                                   batch_size)
        heads_small_chunk = heads_small_chunk.view(num_chunk_heads_small, local_seq_len, chunk_num_heads_small, h_dim,
                                                   batch_size)
        if batch_dim_idx == 0:
            #[all2all_buffer_counts, local_seq_len, n_heads,dim,batch]->[batch,local_seq_len,all2all_buffer_counts*n_heads,dim]
            order = [4, 1, 0, 2, 3]
            heads_large_chunk = heads_large_chunk.permute(order).contiguous().view(batch_size, local_seq_len,
                                                                                   total_num_large_heads, h_dim)
            heads_small_chunk = heads_small_chunk.permute(order).contiguous().view(batch_size, local_seq_len,
                                                                                   total_num_small_heads, h_dim)
        elif batch_dim_idx == 1:
            #[all2all_buffer_counts, local_seq_len, n_heads,dim,batch]->[local_seq_len,batch,all2all_buffer_counts*n_heads,dim]
            order = [1, 4, 0, 2, 3]
            heads_large_chunk = heads_large_chunk.permute(order).contiguous().view(local_seq_len, batch_size,
                                                                                   total_num_large_heads, h_dim)
            heads_small_chunk = heads_small_chunk.permute(order).contiguous().view(local_seq_len, batch_size,
                                                                                   total_num_small_heads, h_dim)

        output = torch.cat([heads_large_chunk, heads_small_chunk], dim=2).contiguous()

        inp_shape[scatter_idx] = inp_shape[scatter_idx] // seq_world_size
        output_shape=  inp_shape[: gather_idx] + \
            [total_h,] + \
            inp_shape[gather_idx + 1:]

        output = output.view(output_shape)

    return output


def single_all_to_all(input,
                      scatter_idx,
                      gather_idx,
                      batch_dim_idx,
                      group,
                      async_op=False,
                      handle=None,
                      type=None,
                      num_kv_heads=None):
    seq_world_size = dist.get_world_size(group)

    num_kv_heads = _resolve_kv_heads(input, scatter_idx, seq_world_size, num_kv_heads)

    # Only an indivisible count needs the uneven implementation. Taking it for every explicit
    # count would push evenly-split models onto it too, and it rejects async_op, which is how
    # the overlapped q/k path runs.
    if num_kv_heads is not None and num_kv_heads % seq_world_size != 0:
        assert async_op == False, "uneven head sp does not support async op"
        return uneven_heads_all2all(input, scatter_idx, gather_idx, batch_dim_idx, group, num_kv_heads)

    pre_all2all_permute_idx, pre_all2all_inp_shape, post_all2all_permute_idx, post_all2all_res_shape = _generate_layout_params(
        scatter_idx, batch_dim_idx, seq_world_size, input)

    input_t = pre_all2all_fun(pre_all2all_permute_idx, pre_all2all_inp_shape, input)

    post_all2all_fun = post_all2all(post_all2all_permute_idx, post_all2all_res_shape)
    output = torch.empty_like(input_t)
    work = dist.all_to_all_single(output, input_t, group=group, async_op=async_op)

    if async_op:
        if type in ('dq', 'dk'):
            handle[type + '_work'] = work
            handle[type + '_grad'] = output
            handle[type + '_post_all2all_func'] = post_all2all_fun
            return output.view(post_all2all_res_shape)

    res = post_all2all_fun(output)
    return res


# A process group cannot appear in an operator schema, so the exchange addresses its group by name and
# resolves the name back to the group when it runs. The registry is written once, when the attention module
# is built: a write issued from inside a compiled region does not land before the operator reads it.
_all_to_all_groups: Dict[str, dist.ProcessGroup] = {}


def register_all_to_all_group(group: dist.ProcessGroup) -> str:
    """Make ``group`` reachable by name from inside the exchange operator, and return that name.

    Call this outside any compiled region, before the first exchange on ``group``.
    """
    name = group.group_name
    _all_to_all_groups[name] = group
    return name


@torch.library.custom_op("deepspeed::dim_zero_all_to_all", mutates_args=())
def _dim_zero_all_to_all_op(input: Tensor, group_name: str) -> Tensor:
    output = torch.empty_like(input)
    dist.all_to_all_single(output, input, group=_all_to_all_groups[group_name])
    return output


@torch.library.register_fake("deepspeed::dim_zero_all_to_all")
def _dim_zero_all_to_all_fake(input: Tensor, group_name: str) -> Tensor:
    return torch.empty_like(input)


def _dim_zero_all_to_all_backward_setup(ctx: Any, inputs: Tuple[Any, ...], output: Tensor) -> None:
    ctx.group_name = inputs[1]


def _dim_zero_all_to_all_backward(ctx: Any, grad: Tensor) -> Tuple[Tensor, None]:
    return (_dim_zero_all_to_all_op(grad.contiguous(), ctx.group_name), None)


torch.library.register_autograd("deepspeed::dim_zero_all_to_all",
                                _dim_zero_all_to_all_backward,
                                setup_context=_dim_zero_all_to_all_backward_setup)


def _dim_zero_all_to_all(group: dist.ProcessGroup, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
    """Differentiable All2All across dimension 0.

    The gradient of this exchange has to be something the tracer knows about. An autograd function that fills
    a caller-allocated buffer with a collective is not: ``torch.compile`` inlines the forward body rather than
    treating the call as opaque, and the traced body allocates an empty tensor and mutates it through an
    operation that does not register as producing data, so the graph holds an output with no dependence on the
    input. Differentiating that yields a zero gradient and the hand-written backward never runs, while the
    forward stays numerically correct -- a training job silently stops updating everything upstream of the
    exchange.

    Registering the exchange as an operator with a declared backward gives the tracer a derivative instead of
    a body to inline, and keeps the collective on ``deepspeed.comm`` so the configured backend dispatches it.
    """
    world_size = dist.get_world_size(group)
    assert input.shape[0] == world_size, f"Dim 0 {input.shape[0]} is not world size"

    return _dim_zero_all_to_all_op(input.contiguous(), group.group_name)


class _SeqAllToAll(torch.autograd.Function):

    @staticmethod
    def forward(ctx: Any,
                group: dist.ProcessGroup,
                input: Tensor,
                scatter_idx: int,
                gather_idx: int,
                batch_dim_idx: int,
                stream=None,
                handle=None,
                type=None,
                is_fwd=True,
                num_kv_heads=None) -> Tensor:
        ctx.group = group
        ctx.scatter_idx = scatter_idx
        ctx.gather_idx = gather_idx
        ctx.stream = stream
        ctx.handle = handle
        ctx.type = type
        ctx.batch_dim_idx = batch_dim_idx
        # Resolve once, here: backward runs with scatter and gather swapped and cannot recover
        # the count from its own already-sharded tensor, so it replays this value.
        num_kv_heads = _resolve_kv_heads(input, scatter_idx, dist.get_world_size(group), num_kv_heads)
        ctx.num_kv_heads = num_kv_heads
        if ctx.handle is None:
            res = single_all_to_all(input,
                                    scatter_idx,
                                    gather_idx,
                                    batch_dim_idx,
                                    group,
                                    False,
                                    num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads)

        else:
            # overlap communication path
            if not is_fwd and type == 'o':
                assert ctx.stream is not None
                res = single_all_to_all(input,
                                        scatter_idx,
                                        gather_idx,
                                        batch_dim_idx,
                                        group,
                                        False,
                                        num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads)
                get_accelerator().current_stream().wait_stream(ctx.stream)
                # The computation of d o_weight can overlap with the communication of d o_input

            elif not is_fwd and type in ('q', 'k'):
                # Achieve communication overlap by pipelining the matrix computation and communication of dq, dk, and dv
                type = 'd' + type
                res = single_all_to_all(input,
                                        scatter_idx,
                                        gather_idx,
                                        batch_dim_idx,
                                        group,
                                        True,
                                        handle,
                                        type,
                                        num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads)

            elif is_fwd and type in ('q', 'k'):
                # Achieve communication overlap by pipelining the matrix computation and communication of q, k, and v
                type = 'fwd_' + type
                res = single_all_to_all(input,
                                        scatter_idx,
                                        gather_idx,
                                        batch_dim_idx,
                                        group,
                                        False,
                                        handle,
                                        type,
                                        num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads)

            else:
                res = single_all_to_all(input,
                                        scatter_idx,
                                        gather_idx,
                                        batch_dim_idx,
                                        group,
                                        False,
                                        num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads)

        return res

    @staticmethod
    def backward(ctx: Any, *grad_output: Tensor) -> Tuple[None, Tensor, None, None]:

        return (None,
                _SeqAllToAll.apply(ctx.group, *grad_output, ctx.gather_idx, ctx.scatter_idx, ctx.batch_dim_idx,
                                   ctx.stream, ctx.handle, ctx.type, False,
                                   ctx.num_kv_heads), None, None, None, None, None, None, None, None)


class DistributedAttention(torch.nn.Module):
    """Initialization.

    Arguments:
        local_attention (Module): local attention with q,k,v
        sequence_process_group (ProcessGroup): sequence parallel process group
        scatter_idx (int): scatter_idx for all2all comm
        gather_idx (int): gather_idx for all2all comm
        num_kv_heads (int): number of key-value heads before sharding, which is what the uneven
            partition follows. Only needed when it does not divide evenly by the sequence
            parallel world size; when omitted it is read from the key tensor of each forward.
        validate_shards (bool): check that each of Q, K and V has the same sequence length
            on every sequence-group rank before each forward's attention data collectives.
            Adds one metadata all-gather and host synchronization per forward; disabled by default.
            All group members must enable this flag consistently and participate in every forward.
            Inconsistent flags cannot be detected without communication in the default path.
            Only sequence lengths are checked, not other shapes, dtypes or devices. Query and
            KV sequence lengths may differ. No padding is added: callers must provide equal
            shards and own any padding, attention masks and loss masking.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        local_attention: Module,
        sequence_process_group: dist.ProcessGroup,
        scatter_idx: int = 2,
        gather_idx: int = 0,
        sp_stream=None,
        num_kv_heads: int = None,
        validate_shards: bool = False,
    ) -> None:

        super(DistributedAttention, self).__init__()
        self.local_attn = local_attention
        self.spg = sequence_process_group
        # Kept per instance: a second model with a different head count must not decide how this
        # one is sharded.
        self.num_kv_heads = num_kv_heads
        self.validate_shards = validate_shards
        self.scatter_idx = scatter_idx
        self.gather_idx = gather_idx
        self.sp_overlap_comm = False
        self.overlap_handles = None
        self.sp_stream = sp_stream
        if sp_stream is not None:
            self.overlap_handles = {}
            self.sp_overlap_comm = True
            self.default_stream = get_accelerator().default_stream()

    def _validate_shard_lengths(self, query, key, value, batch_dim_idx):
        seq_dim = 1 - batch_dim_idx
        lengths = torch.tensor([tensor.shape[seq_dim] for tensor in (query, key, value)],
                               dtype=torch.int64,
                               device=query.device)
        gathered = [torch.empty_like(lengths) for _ in range(dist.get_world_size(self.spg))]
        dist.all_gather(gathered, lengths, group=self.spg)
        rank_lengths = [metadata.tolist() for metadata in gathered]
        mismatches = []
        for index, name in enumerate(('query', 'key', 'value')):
            sizes = [metadata[index] for metadata in rank_lengths]
            if any(size != sizes[0] for size in sizes[1:]):
                details = ', '.join(f'group rank {rank}: {size}' for rank, size in enumerate(sizes))
                mismatches.append(f'{name} sequence lengths [{details}]')
        if mismatches:
            raise ValueError('DistributedAttention requires equal sequence shards across ranks: ' +
                             '; '.join(mismatches))

    def layer_sync(self, layer):
        if self.sp_overlap_comm and hasattr(layer, 'done_event'):
            self.default_stream.wait_event(layer.done_event)

    def forward(self,
                query: Tensor,
                key: Tensor,
                value: Tensor,
                batch_dim_idx: int,
                rotary_pos_emb=None,
                *args: Any,
                **kwargs) -> Tensor:
        """ forward

        Arguments:
            query (Tensor): query input to the layer
            key (Tensor): key input to the layer
            value (Tensor): value input to the layer
            batch_dim_idx (int): indicating which dim is batch
            args: other args

        Returns:
            * output (Tensor): context output
        """

        if self.validate_shards:
            self._validate_shard_lengths(query, key, value, batch_dim_idx)

        # TODO Merge three alltoall calls into one
        # TODO (Reza): change the api on the megatron-deepspeed side so that we only receive all data (q,k, and v) together!
        #in shape : e.g.,  [s/p:h:]

        def bwd_hook(layer_type):

            def hook_fun(grad):
                type = 'd' + layer_type
                self.overlap_handles[type + '_work'].wait()
                self.sp_stream.wait_stream(self.default_stream)
                all2all_output = self.overlap_handles[type + '_grad']
                return self.overlap_handles[type + '_post_all2all_func'](all2all_output)

            return hook_fun

        # The partition follows KV groups, so the count comes off the key tensor: under GQA a
        # query head has to land on the rank holding its KV head, and splitting on the query
        # count would tear the group apart.
        num_kv_heads = self.num_kv_heads if self.num_kv_heads is not None else key.shape[2]

        self.layer_sync(query)
        query_layer = _SeqAllToAll.apply(self.spg, query, self.scatter_idx, self.gather_idx, batch_dim_idx, None,
                                         self.overlap_handles, 'q', True, num_kv_heads)
        self.layer_sync(key)
        key_layer = _SeqAllToAll.apply(self.spg, key, self.scatter_idx, self.gather_idx, batch_dim_idx, None,
                                       self.overlap_handles, 'k', True, num_kv_heads)
        if self.sp_overlap_comm:
            self.default_stream.wait_stream(self.sp_stream)

        value_layer = _SeqAllToAll.apply(self.spg, value, self.scatter_idx, self.gather_idx, batch_dim_idx, None,
                                         self.overlap_handles, 'v', True, num_kv_heads)

        if self.sp_overlap_comm:
            # Register a hook to synchronize dq and dk after the all-to-all
            # operation when the gradient data is used.
            # Place this logic after the q, k, v all-to-all operation to
            # improve interpreter speed to
            # call and launch of the forward all-to-all communication.
            query.register_hook(bwd_hook(layer_type='q'))
            key.register_hook(bwd_hook(layer_type='k'))

        #out shape : e.g., [s:h/p:]
        if rotary_pos_emb is not None:
            pos_emb_cos, pos_emb_sin = rotary_pos_emb[0].permute(1, 0, 2, 3), rotary_pos_emb[1].permute(1, 0, 2, 3)
            query_layer = apply_rotary_pos_emb(query_layer, pos_emb_cos, pos_emb_sin)
            key_layer = apply_rotary_pos_emb(key_layer, pos_emb_cos, pos_emb_sin)

        context_layer = self.local_attn(query_layer, key_layer, value_layer, *args, **kwargs)

        output = _SeqAllToAll.apply(self.spg, context_layer, self.gather_idx, self.scatter_idx, batch_dim_idx,
                                    self.sp_stream, self.overlap_handles, 'o', True, num_kv_heads)

        #out e.g., [s/p::h]
        return output

122	def _rotate_half(x):
123	    """
124	    change sign so the last dimension becomes [-odd, +even]
125	    """
126	    x = rearrange(x, '... (j d) -> ... j d', j=2)
127	    x1, x2 = x.unbind(dim=-2)
128	    return torch.cat((-x2, x1), dim=-1)

131	def apply_rotary_pos_emb(t, freqs_cos, freqs_sin):
132	    """
133	    input tensor t is of shape [seq_length, ..., dim]
134	    rotary positional embeding tensor freqs is of shape [seq_length, ..., dim]
135	    check https://kexue.fm/archives/8265 for detailed formulas
136	    """
137	    rot_dim = freqs_cos.shape[-1]
138	    # ideally t_pass is empty so rotary pos embedding is applied to all tensor t
139	    t, t_pass = t[..., :rot_dim], t[..., rot_dim:]
140	
141	    # torchembed's fused kernel takes cos/sin caches of shape [seq_length, rot_dim] and
142	    # applies them along the second-to-last axis of t. Some callers (e.g. fpdt_layer.py)
143	    # pass tensors where the sequence dim isn't at position 0, so only take the fused path
144	    # when t's dim 0 unambiguously matches the freqs' sequence dim (with no other
145	    # non-broadcast dims in freqs); otherwise fall back to the reference path.
146	    if (_torchembed_available and get_accelerator().on_accelerator(t) and rot_dim % 2 == 0
147	            and freqs_cos.shape[0] == t.shape[0] and freqs_cos.numel() == freqs_cos.shape[0] * rot_dim):
148	        freqs_cos_2d = freqs_cos.reshape(freqs_cos.shape[0], rot_dim)
149	        freqs_sin_2d = freqs_sin.reshape(freqs_sin.shape[0], rot_dim)
150	        # torchembed expects the sequence dim second-to-last: (*leading, seq_len, dim)
151	        t_kernel = t.movedim(0, -2).contiguous()
152	        t_out, _ = _torchembed_rope_forward(t_kernel, t_kernel, freqs_cos_2d, freqs_sin_2d)
153	        t = t_out.movedim(-2, 0).contiguous()
154	    else:
155	        # first part is cosine component
156	        # second part is sine component, need to change signs with _rotate_half method
157	        t = (t * freqs_cos) + (_rotate_half(t) * freqs_sin)
158	
159	    res = t if t_pass.shape[-1] == 0 else torch.cat((t, t_pass), dim=-1)
160	    return res

163	def uneven_heads_all2all(input, scatter_idx, gather_idx, batch_dim_idx, group, num_kv_heads):
164	    seq_world_size = dist.get_world_size(group)
165	    # AutoTPMeta is built here rather than threaded: the partition follows this all-to-all's own
166	    # KV count, and the shard helper is the only thing that needs it in that shape.
167	    meta = AutoTPMeta(num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads)
168	    inp_shape = list(input.shape)
169	    assert batch_dim_idx in [0, 1], "batch_dim_idx must be either 0 or 1"
170	
171	    if not (scatter_idx < 2):
172	        input_splits = get_shard_size_list(inp_shape[scatter_idx], seq_world_size, meta)
173	        input = input.transpose(0, scatter_idx).contiguous()
174	        local_heads = input_splits[groups._get_sequence_parallel_rank()]
175	        output_splits = [local_heads] * seq_world_size
176	
177	        output_buffer_shape = [seq_world_size * local_heads] + list(input.shape[1:])
178	        output = torch.empty(output_buffer_shape, device=input.device, dtype=input.dtype)
179	        dist.all_to_all_single(output,input,output_split_sizes=output_splits,\
180	            input_split_sizes=input_splits,group=group)
181	        ###[seq_ws*local_heads, ...] to [seq_ws, local_heads, ...]
182	        output = output.view(seq_world_size, local_heads, *output.shape[1:])
183	        ###[seq_ws,local_heads,b,seq_len,...] to [seq_ws,seq_len,b,local_heads,...]
184	
185	        ### batch_dim_idx=0 [seq_ws,local_heads,seq_len,b,...] to [b, seq_ws, seq_len, local_heads ...]
186	        ### batch_dim_idx=1 [seq_ws,local_heads,b,seq_len,...] to [seq_ws,seq_len,b,local_heads,...]
187	        if batch_dim_idx == 0:
188	            order = [3, 0, 2, 1] + list(range(4, len(output.shape)))
189	            output = output.permute(order).contiguous()
190	            ###[b, seq_ws*local_seq_len, local_heads,...]
191	            output = output.view(output.shape[0], inp_shape[gather_idx] * seq_world_size,
192	                                 *output.shape[3:]).contiguous()
193	        elif batch_dim_idx == 1:
194	            output = output.transpose(1, 3).contiguous()
195	            ###[seq_ws*local_seq_len, b, local_heads,...]
196	            output = output.view(inp_shape[gather_idx] * seq_world_size, *output.shape[2:]).contiguous()
197	    else:
198	        # The compatibility handling of 4D and 3D tensors, standardizing to 3D.
199	        input = input.reshape(input.shape[0], input.shape[1], -1)
200	
201	        if batch_dim_idx == 0:  #b,s,h
202	            input = input.permute(1, 2, 0).contiguous()  #s,h,b
203	        elif batch_dim_idx == 1:  #s,b,h
204	            input = input.transpose(1, 2).contiguous()  #s,h,b
205	        seq_len, h, batch_size = input.shape
206	        num_local_heads_list = get_shard_size_list(num_kv_heads, seq_world_size, meta)
207	        local_heads = num_local_heads_list[groups._get_sequence_parallel_rank()]
208	        h_dim = h // local_heads
209	        local_seq_len = seq_len // seq_world_size
210	
211	        input = input.view(seq_len * h, batch_size)
212	        local_seq_len_with_heads = int(input.shape[0] / seq_world_size)  # dim size of local_seq_len*local_heads*hdim
213	        input_splits = [local_seq_len_with_heads] * seq_world_size
214	        coeff = local_seq_len_with_heads // local_heads  #per head: dim size of local_seq_len*hdim
215	
216	        #uneven seq_world_size coeff,  total_heads/local_heads.
217	        heads_scale_coeff = num_kv_heads / local_heads
218	
219	        output_splits = [num_local_heads * coeff for num_local_heads in num_local_heads_list]
220	        output_buff_d1_size = int(heads_scale_coeff * local_seq_len_with_heads)
221	        total_h = int(inp_shape[gather_idx] * heads_scale_coeff)
222	        output = torch.empty(output_buff_d1_size, input.shape[1], device=input.device, dtype=input.dtype)
223	        dist.all_to_all_single(output,input,output_split_sizes=output_splits, \
224	            input_split_sizes=input_splits,group=group)
225	        ##################
226	        #suppose 7 heads divide into 4 ranks [2,2,2,1]
227	        #chunk_num_heads_small=floor(7/4)=1
228	        #chunk_num_heads_large=ceil(7/4)=2
229	        #num_chunk_heads_large=len([2,2,2])=3, all2all_buffer_counts
230	        #num_chunk_heads_small=len([1])=1, all2all_buffer_counts
231	        #total_num_large_heads=sum([2,2,2])=7
232	        #total_num_small_heads=sum([1])=1
233	
234	        chunk_num_heads_small = num_kv_heads // seq_world_size  # even heads compatible
235	        chunk_num_heads_large = chunk_num_heads_small + 1
236	        num_chunk_heads_large = num_kv_heads % seq_world_size
237	        num_chunk_heads_small = seq_world_size - num_chunk_heads_large
238	        total_num_large_heads = num_chunk_heads_large * chunk_num_heads_large
239	        total_num_small_heads = num_chunk_heads_small * chunk_num_heads_small
240	
241	        heads_large_combine_size = coeff * total_num_large_heads
242	        heads_small_combine_size = coeff * total_num_small_heads
243	        heads_large_chunk, heads_small_chunk = output.split([heads_large_combine_size, heads_small_combine_size],
244	                                                            dim=0)
245	        heads_large_chunk = heads_large_chunk.view(num_chunk_heads_large, local_seq_len, chunk_num_heads_large, h_dim,
246	                                                   batch_size)
247	        heads_small_chunk = heads_small_chunk.view(num_chunk_heads_small, local_seq_len, chunk_num_heads_small, h_dim,
248	                                                   batch_size)
249	        if batch_dim_idx == 0:
250	            #[all2all_buffer_counts, local_seq_len, n_heads,dim,batch]->[batch,local_seq_len,all2all_buffer_counts*n_heads,dim]
251	            order = [4, 1, 0, 2, 3]
252	            heads_large_chunk = heads_large_chunk.permute(order).contiguous().view(batch_size, local_seq_len,
253	                                                                                   total_num_large_heads, h_dim)
254	            heads_small_chunk = heads_small_chunk.permute(order).contiguous().view(batch_size, local_seq_len,
255	                                                                                   total_num_small_heads, h_dim)
256	        elif batch_dim_idx == 1:
257	            #[all2all_buffer_counts, local_seq_len, n_heads,dim,batch]->[local_seq_len,batch,all2all_buffer_counts*n_heads,dim]
258	            order = [1, 4, 0, 2, 3]
259	            heads_large_chunk = heads_large_chunk.permute(order).contiguous().view(local_seq_len, batch_size,
260	                                                                                   total_num_large_heads, h_dim)
261	            heads_small_chunk = heads_small_chunk.permute(order).contiguous().view(local_seq_len, batch_size,
262	                                                                                   total_num_small_heads, h_dim)
263	
264	        output = torch.cat([heads_large_chunk, heads_small_chunk], dim=2).contiguous()
265	
266	        inp_shape[scatter_idx] = inp_shape[scatter_idx] // seq_world_size
267	        output_shape=  inp_shape[: gather_idx] + \
268	            [total_h,] + \
269	            inp_shape[gather_idx + 1:]
270	
271	        output = output.view(output_shape)
272	
273	    return output

276	def single_all_to_all(input,
277	                      scatter_idx,
278	                      gather_idx,
279	                      batch_dim_idx,
280	                      group,
281	                      async_op=False,
282	                      handle=None,
283	                      type=None,
284	                      num_kv_heads=None):
285	    seq_world_size = dist.get_world_size(group)
286	
287	    num_kv_heads = _resolve_kv_heads(input, scatter_idx, seq_world_size, num_kv_heads)
288	
289	    # Only an indivisible count needs the uneven implementation. Taking it for every explicit
290	    # count would push evenly-split models onto it too, and it rejects async_op, which is how
291	    # the overlapped q/k path runs.
292	    if num_kv_heads is not None and num_kv_heads % seq_world_size != 0:
293	        assert async_op == False, "uneven head sp does not support async op"
294	        return uneven_heads_all2all(input, scatter_idx, gather_idx, batch_dim_idx, group, num_kv_heads)
295	
296	    pre_all2all_permute_idx, pre_all2all_inp_shape, post_all2all_permute_idx, post_all2all_res_shape = _generate_layout_params(
297	        scatter_idx, batch_dim_idx, seq_world_size, input)
298	
299	    input_t = pre_all2all_fun(pre_all2all_permute_idx, pre_all2all_inp_shape, input)
300	
301	    post_all2all_fun = post_all2all(post_all2all_permute_idx, post_all2all_res_shape)
302	    output = torch.empty_like(input_t)
303	    work = dist.all_to_all_single(output, input_t, group=group, async_op=async_op)
304	
305	    if async_op:
306	        if type in ('dq', 'dk'):
307	            handle[type + '_work'] = work
308	            handle[type + '_grad'] = output
309	            handle[type + '_post_all2all_func'] = post_all2all_fun
310	            return output.view(post_all2all_res_shape)
311	
312	    res = post_all2all_fun(output)
313	    return res

357	def _dim_zero_all_to_all(group: dist.ProcessGroup, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
358	    """Differentiable All2All across dimension 0.
359	
360	    The gradient of this exchange has to be something the tracer knows about. An autograd function that fills
361	    a caller-allocated buffer with a collective is not: ``torch.compile`` inlines the forward body rather than
362	    treating the call as opaque, and the traced body allocates an empty tensor and mutates it through an
363	    operation that does not register as producing data, so the graph holds an output with no dependence on the
364	    input. Differentiating that yields a zero gradient and the hand-written backward never runs, while the
365	    forward stays numerically correct -- a training job silently stops updating everything upstream of the
366	    exchange.
367	
368	    Registering the exchange as an operator with a declared backward gives the tracer a derivative instead of
369	    a body to inline, and keeps the collective on ``deepspeed.comm`` so the configured backend dispatches it.
370	    """
371	    world_size = dist.get_world_size(group)
372	    assert input.shape[0] == world_size, f"Dim 0 {input.shape[0]} is not world size"
373	
374	    return _dim_zero_all_to_all_op(input.contiguous(), group.group_name)

377	class _SeqAllToAll(torch.autograd.Function):

379	    @staticmethod
380	    def forward(ctx: Any,
381	                group: dist.ProcessGroup,
382	                input: Tensor,
383	                scatter_idx: int,
384	                gather_idx: int,
385	                batch_dim_idx: int,
386	                stream=None,
387	                handle=None,
388	                type=None,
389	                is_fwd=True,
390	                num_kv_heads=None) -> Tensor:
391	        ctx.group = group
392	        ctx.scatter_idx = scatter_idx
393	        ctx.gather_idx = gather_idx
394	        ctx.stream = stream
395	        ctx.handle = handle
396	        ctx.type = type
397	        ctx.batch_dim_idx = batch_dim_idx
398	        # Resolve once, here: backward runs with scatter and gather swapped and cannot recover
399	        # the count from its own already-sharded tensor, so it replays this value.
400	        num_kv_heads = _resolve_kv_heads(input, scatter_idx, dist.get_world_size(group), num_kv_heads)
401	        ctx.num_kv_heads = num_kv_heads
402	        if ctx.handle is None:
403	            res = single_all_to_all(input,
404	                                    scatter_idx,
405	                                    gather_idx,
406	                                    batch_dim_idx,
407	                                    group,
408	                                    False,
409	                                    num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads)
410	
411	        else:
412	            # overlap communication path
413	            if not is_fwd and type == 'o':
414	                assert ctx.stream is not None
415	                res = single_all_to_all(input,
416	                                        scatter_idx,
417	                                        gather_idx,
418	                                        batch_dim_idx,
419	                                        group,
420	                                        False,
421	                                        num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads)
422	                get_accelerator().current_stream().wait_stream(ctx.stream)
423	                # The computation of d o_weight can overlap with the communication of d o_input
424	
425	            elif not is_fwd and type in ('q', 'k'):
426	                # Achieve communication overlap by pipelining the matrix computation and communication of dq, dk, and dv
427	                type = 'd' + type
428	                res = single_all_to_all(input,
429	                                        scatter_idx,
430	                                        gather_idx,
431	                                        batch_dim_idx,
432	                                        group,
433	                                        True,
434	                                        handle,
435	                                        type,
436	                                        num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads)
437	
438	            elif is_fwd and type in ('q', 'k'):
439	                # Achieve communication overlap by pipelining the matrix computation and communication of q, k, and v
440	                type = 'fwd_' + type
441	                res = single_all_to_all(input,
442	                                        scatter_idx,
443	                                        gather_idx,
444	                                        batch_dim_idx,
445	                                        group,
446	                                        False,
447	                                        handle,
448	                                        type,
449	                                        num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads)
450	
451	            else:
452	                res = single_all_to_all(input,
453	                                        scatter_idx,
454	                                        gather_idx,
455	                                        batch_dim_idx,
456	                                        group,
457	                                        False,
458	                                        num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads)
459	
460	        return res
461	
462	    @staticmethod
463	    def backward(ctx: Any, *grad_output: Tensor) -> Tuple[None, Tensor, None, None]:
464	
465	        return (None,
466	                _SeqAllToAll.apply(ctx.group, *grad_output, ctx.gather_idx, ctx.scatter_idx, ctx.batch_dim_idx,
467	                                   ctx.stream, ctx.handle, ctx.type, False,
468	                                   ctx.num_kv_heads), None, None, None, None, None, None, None, None)

471	class DistributedAttention(torch.nn.Module):
472	    """Initialization.
473	
474	    Arguments:
475	        local_attention (Module): local attention with q,k,v
476	        sequence_process_group (ProcessGroup): sequence parallel process group
477	        scatter_idx (int): scatter_idx for all2all comm
478	        gather_idx (int): gather_idx for all2all comm
479	        num_kv_heads (int): number of key-value heads before sharding, which is what the uneven
480	            partition follows. Only needed when it does not divide evenly by the sequence
481	            parallel world size; when omitted it is read from the key tensor of each forward.
482	        validate_shards (bool): check that each of Q, K and V has the same sequence length
483	            on every sequence-group rank before each forward's attention data collectives.
484	            Adds one metadata all-gather and host synchronization per forward; disabled by default.
485	            All group members must enable this flag consistently and participate in every forward.
486	            Inconsistent flags cannot be detected without communication in the default path.
487	            Only sequence lengths are checked, not other shapes, dtypes or devices. Query and
488	            KV sequence lengths may differ. No padding is added: callers must provide equal
489	            shards and own any padding, attention masks and loss masking.
490	    """
491	
492	    def __init__(
493	        self,
494	        local_attention: Module,
495	        sequence_process_group: dist.ProcessGroup,
496	        scatter_idx: int = 2,
497	        gather_idx: int = 0,
498	        sp_stream=None,
499	        num_kv_heads: int = None,
500	        validate_shards: bool = False,
501	    ) -> None:
502	
503	        super(DistributedAttention, self).__init__()
504	        self.local_attn = local_attention
505	        self.spg = sequence_process_group
506	        # Kept per instance: a second model with a different head count must not decide how this
507	        # one is sharded.
508	        self.num_kv_heads = num_kv_heads
509	        self.validate_shards = validate_shards
510	        self.scatter_idx = scatter_idx
511	        self.gather_idx = gather_idx
512	        self.sp_overlap_comm = False
513	        self.overlap_handles = None
514	        self.sp_stream = sp_stream
515	        if sp_stream is not None:
516	            self.overlap_handles = {}
517	            self.sp_overlap_comm = True
518	            self.default_stream = get_accelerator().default_stream()
519	
520	    def _validate_shard_lengths(self, query, key, value, batch_dim_idx):
521	        seq_dim = 1 - batch_dim_idx
522	        lengths = torch.tensor([tensor.shape[seq_dim] for tensor in (query, key, value)],
523	                               dtype=torch.int64,
524	                               device=query.device)
525	        gathered = [torch.empty_like(lengths) for _ in range(dist.get_world_size(self.spg))]
526	        dist.all_gather(gathered, lengths, group=self.spg)
527	        rank_lengths = [metadata.tolist() for metadata in gathered]
528	        mismatches = []
529	        for index, name in enumerate(('query', 'key', 'value')):
530	            sizes = [metadata[index] for metadata in rank_lengths]
531	            if any(size != sizes[0] for size in sizes[1:]):
532	                details = ', '.join(f'group rank {rank}: {size}' for rank, size in enumerate(sizes))
533	                mismatches.append(f'{name} sequence lengths [{details}]')
534	        if mismatches:
535	            raise ValueError('DistributedAttention requires equal sequence shards across ranks: ' +
536	                             '; '.join(mismatches))

540	            self.default_stream.wait_event(layer.done_event)

551

569	
570	        def bwd_hook(layer_type):
571	
572	            def hook_fun(grad):
573	                type = 'd' + layer_type
574	                self.overlap_handles[type + '_work'].wait()
575	                self.sp_stream.wait_stream(self.default_stream)
576	                all2all_output = self.overlap_handles[type + '_grad']
577	                return self.overlap_handles[type + '_post_all2all_func'](all2all_output)
578	
579	            return hook_fun

581	        # The partition follows KV groups, so the count comes off the key tensor: under GQA a
582	        # query head has to land on the rank holding its KV head, and splitting on the query
583	        # count would tear the group apart.
584	        num_kv_heads = self.num_kv_heads if self.num_kv_heads is not None else key.shape[2]

588	                                         self.overlap_handles, 'q', True, num_kv_heads)
589	        self.layer_sync(key)
590	        key_layer = _SeqAllToAll.apply(self.spg, key, self.scatter_idx, self.gather_idx, batch_dim_idx, None,
591	                                       self.overlap_handles, 'k', True, num_kv_heads)
592	        if self.sp_overlap_comm:

596	                                         self.overlap_handles, 'v', True, num_kv_heads)
